integrity_notes: The sharp threshold follows from an explicit positive quadratic drift identity; finite rational checks corroborate algebra and are not used as an infinite proof. Bibliographic equivalence in more general stochastic delayed-recursion literature remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Positive diagonal real systems, fixed independent sampling with positive probabilities, one globally consistent stale step, constant positive relaxation and exact arithmetic. No statement for coupled systems, adaptive sampling, local-fresh asynchronous reads, or real-runtime performance.
title: A sharp sampling-concentration frontier for one-step stale randomized Gauss–Seidel
